limitations: RPO is the backup interval; no schedule exists yet (Phase 6). The 23.6 s 'window' in the raw output is only backup duration.
Backup stops CVAT API/workers (~25 s here) for cross-store consistency; it is not an online backup.
Kvrocks cache/queue DB is not backed up (transient: RQ queues, chunk cache); in-flight jobs at backup time are lost and must be re-run by the integration's retry/reconcile.
S3-resident media is out of scope of this script (local volume only); object-reference integrity is checked via media sha256 in labeling_task.clip.
Dataset is tiny; restore time at real scale is a Phase 6 measurement.
